questions.question:
Select the appropriate synonym for the underlined word.

The symbols were __useless__ to him.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option (1)** i.e. **'worthless'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Useless: **(अनुपयोगी) having no value or purpose.

 
 
• **Example: **He has two old smartphones which are totally **useless**.
 
 
 
• **Worthless:** (किसी काम का नहीं) having no value or being of very low value.
 
 
• **Example: **His promises were **worthless.**
 
 
 
• From the above examples it is clear that '**Useless' **and '**Worthless'** are similar to each other.

*Therefore, the correct answer is '**worthless'.*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Successful: **(सफल) achieving a desired outcome or goal.
 
• **Valuable: **(मूल्यवान) having great worth or importance.
 
• **Reachable: **(पहुँचने योग्य) capable of being reached or accessed.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The innovation in the product __catapulted__ the company's growth.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Accelerated'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**Catapulted**' means something that has suddenly achieved a lot of success or popularity. (मिनार की तरह ऊचा करना)

 
 
• **Example**: The success of the film **catapulted **her into stardom.
 
 
 
• The correct synonym '**Accelerated**' means to increase the speed or rate of something. (तेज करना)
 
 
• **Example**: The training program was designed to **accelerate **learning.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct synonym is '**Accelerated**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is** “Option 2”.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '**Retarded**' means to delay or hold back in terms of progress or development. (मंद)
 
• '**Hindered**' refers to creating difficulties for something, resulting in delay or obstruction. (बाधा डालना)
 
• '**Decelerated**' means to reduce the speed or rate of something. (मंद करना)

questions.question:
**Select the appropriate synonym for the underlined word.**

They have no reason to __trust__ you.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Believe**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Trust **is a belief in the reliability, honesty, and integrity of someone or something. (ट्रस्ट विश्वास)

 
 
• **Example**: *I trust my best friend with my secrets because I know she won't betray my confidence.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Believe **means to accept something as true or real based on evidence, faith, or conviction. (भरोसा रखना)
 
 
• **Example**: *I believe in the power of hard work; if you put in the effort, you can achieve your goals.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the synonym for "trust" is "believe".
 
• Trust often involves a deeper level of personal connection and reliability in interpersonal relationships, whereas belief can apply to a broader range of ideas and concepts.

Hence, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Condemn **means to express strong disapproval of something. (निंदा करना)
 
• **Dispute **means to argue or disagree with something. (विवाद)
 
• **Doubt **means to have uncertainty or lack of confidence in something. (संदेह)

Accord
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'agreement.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Accord **refers to a formal agreement or harmony between people or groups. (अनुसंधान का अर्थ है **"लोगों या समूहों के बीच एक औपचारिक समझौता या सामंजस्य।")**
 
• **Synonyms for Accord: Agreement**, pact, treaty, harmony.
 
 
• **Example Sentence:** The two countries reached an **accord **to halt the production of nuclear weapons.
 
 
 
• An **agreement **is a negotiated arrangement between two parties. It's a mutual understanding or arrangement that is typically in written form. (**समझौता दो पक्षों के बीच एक निपटान व्यवस्था है। यह आमतौर पर लिखित रूप में होती है।)**
 
 
• **Example Sentence: **They signed an **agreement **to collaborate on a new project.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Assail: **To attack or criticize forcefully. (**हमला करना या मजबूती से आलोचना करना।)**
 
• **Capricious:** Characterized by sudden and unaccountable changes in mood or behavior. **(मनोवृत्ति या व्यवहार में अचानक और ग़ैरजिम्मेदार** **परिवर्तनों से वैशिष्ट।**)
 
• **Bravado**: A show of boldness intended to impress or intimidate. (**प्रभाव डालने या धमकी देने का एक साहसपूर्ण प्रदर्शन।)**

• The given sentence describes the salesperson as having an affable nature, which means they are pleasant and easy to talk to, making customers feel comfortable during the sales pitch.

• Rude: Disrespectful or impolite. (अपमानजनक या असभ्य)
 
• Aggressive: Forcibly attacking or assertive. (जबरदस्ती हमला करना या मुखर होना)

Directions: Each item in this section consists of a sentence with an underlined word followed by four words/group of words. Select the option that is nearest in meaning to the underlined word and mark your response on the answer sheet accordingly.

The __contentious__ issue of gun control sparked heated debates in the legislature.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** “Controversial”.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Contentious**: Causing or likely to cause disagreement or argument; controversial. (असहमति या तर्क पैदा करने या पैदा होने की संभावना; विवादास्पद।)

 
 
• **Example**- The contentious topic of abortion rights continues to divide public opinion.
 
 
 
• **Controversial**: relating to or causing much discussion, disagreement, or argument. (बहुत अधिक चर्चा, असहमति या तर्क-वितर्क से संबंधित या उत्पन्न करने वाला)
 
• Hence, the option that is Opposite in meaning to the given word is 'Uncontroversial'.

**Therefore, the correct answer is ‘Option 2’.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Peaceful**: Free from violence or disturbance; tranquil. (हिंसा या अशांति से मुक्त; शांत।) 
 
• **Agreeable**: Pleasing or acceptable to someone. (किसी को प्रसन्न या स्वीकार्य।)
 
• **Cooperative**: Willing to work together with others. (दूसरों के साथ मिलकर काम करने के लिए तैयार।)
